title: docs/13-live/live-readiness.json
description: Written by pipeline/tools/live-check.mjs. One row per P6 item. `state: ready` means the item can be exercised, not that a file with the right name exists — live-check asks the docker daemon and the binaries, and reads the calibration score for this pipeline version.

verifiedAt.description: set by `verify`, which also exercises the binaries

exercised.description: true when verify --run proved the binaries answer

next.description: copy-pasteable commands, in order; never prose

accept.description: what a human has to see before this item may be called done

flips.description: the existing gate that consumes this item's evidence — live-check adds no gate of its own
